title: A new system for studying neuronal remodeling and its relation to behavior in Drosophila.
source_locator: Supplementary Fig. 3E (Supplementary Information MOESM2, p. 8-9); anatomy Fig. 3F
quote: Optogenetic activation of both MooSEZ split GAL4 driver lines elicits pronounced motor response of backward walking.
mapping_basis: The paper only describes 'a bilateral pair of SEZ descending neurons with somata at the medial anterior part of the SEZ' (Fig. 3F) without a type name; no kit entry for this line, so no MANC type can be assigned.
stimulation: 617 nm red light, ~26 mW/cm2, 2-s pulse
type_coverage: bilateral pair of SEZ DNs (plus MooSEZs)
sensory_condition: open arena (60 mm), IR illumination, flies in groups or individually
other_cell_types: MooSEZ (bilateral SEZ neuron, brain-intrinsic in adult; not a DN)
penetrance: significant backward translational velocity vs parental controls (p<0.0001)
notes: The authors attribute backward walking to MooSEZ (not a DN), not to the co-labelled SEZ DN pair; the DN record is non-specific with respect to the effect. title: Neural circuit mechanisms for steering control in walking Drosophila

mapping_basis: Paper's name DNa02 is a MANC/Namiki type name in type_list.csv; line SS00730 maps to DNa02 in driver_lines.csv.
stimulation: 617 nm light from above the head, 68 uW/mm2, 0.5 s every 11 s, 150 trials
sensory_condition: walking on spherical treadmill; head cuticle intact; symmetric illumination of head
coordination_notes: ipsiversive steering bias (toward the ReaChR+ side)
penetrance: small average ipsilateral bias; mean of unilateral flies outside bootstrap 95% CI of bilateral controls
n_flies_note: Fig. 8B legend: mean of 16/17 flies (uni/bilateral); Methods report 9 left-only + 8 right-only brains (17) among 73 experiments
notes: Flies were walking on the ball when stimulated; only rotational velocity analysed. Forward-velocity changes were attributed to visual startle (see bilateral record). Expression produced by hs-FLP stochastic flip-out of a ReaChR cassette; coded expression = unilateral for this group. 'Simulated fly' in Fig. 8C legend refers to the authors' own bootstrap control, not a connectome model.
